CRLR No.737 of 2025
With
(Delay Condonation Appl. No.01 of 2025)
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Mohd. Safdar, learned counsel for the 
Revisionist.
2. There is delay of 40 days in filing the 
instant criminal revision. 
3. The reasons given for condoning the delay 
is that the revisionist could not procure 
sufficient fund to proceed to the present revision 
hence, delay. The reasons shown in the affidavit 
filed in support of delay condonation application 
are sufficient to condone the delay. The delay is 
condoned. Accordingly delay condonation 
application is allowed. 
4. Admit.
5. Issue notice to the respondent.
6. Steps be taken within one week.
7. List on 30.12.2025. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 24.11.2025
